annotations.title: Which plan keeps the most at my volume

description: Compares selling plans at a price and monthly sales volume for Payhip Free, Plus and Pro, Gumroad direct and Discover, Ko-fi Shop and Ko-fi Gold, and Shopify Basic, Grow and Advanced, each billed monthly or yearly. Use it when a US seller asks which of those plans keeps the most after per-sale fees and monthly plan cost, or where the break-even between tiers falls. Do not use it for Etsy, Notion Marketplace or Square (they have no plan choice in the fee data, so use fees_breakdown), for sellers outside the US, for international cards, for Amazon FBA, for competitor repricing, for VAT, refunds, disputes, payout fees or ads. Inputs are price and sales_per_month. Optional processor, cost, and a platforms filter. A plan without sourced numbers is left out and named. US sellers, domestic cards. Read-only.

cost.description: Optional cost per item sold in USD, so the answer adds profit_per_month_usd and counts it in sales_to_cover_plan_cost. Default 0.

platforms.description: Optional filter: families (payhip, gumroad, ko-fi, shopify) and/or plan ids (payhip-free, payhip-plus, payhip-pro, gumroad-direct, gumroad-discover, ko-fi-shop, ko-fi-gold, shopify-basic-monthly, shopify-basic-yearly, shopify-grow-monthly, shopify-grow-yearly, shopify-advanced-monthly, shopify-advanced-yearly). Leave it out to compare every plan.

price.description: Your sale price per item in USD before buyer sales tax, in whole cents, e.g. 17.

processor.description: Card processor for the plans where you add your own (Payhip plans, Ko-fi Shop and Ko-fi Gold). "stripe" = 2.9% + $0.30 (default). "paypal" = PayPal Checkout or Guest Checkout, 3.49% + $0.49. Domestic cards only. Gumroad and Shopify charge their own processing.

sales_per_month.description: How many sales you make (or expect) in a month, a whole number, e.g. 50.
